newsitem.title: MEXICO: Grupo Carso $500 mln loan seen for this week.
newsitem.headline: Grupo Carso $500 mln loan seen for this week.

text.p: Grupo Carso SA de CV will likely take out a five-year $500 million syndicated loan this week, sources said on Tuesday.
"I think that we will announce it this week, but we still need to iron out some details," the source, who declined to be identified, said.
The loan is seen carrying a spread of 70 basis points over Libor, and will be used to replace more expensive or shorter-term debt, the source said.
"All of it will be used to substitute debt," the source said.
Bank of America, Chase Manhattan and SBC Warburg are seen leading the issue.

The issue is seen being partially used to pay back the $103 million bridge loan that Carso took out with BankAmerica Corp to settle payment of the 60-percent stake it bought of Sears Roebuck de Mexico SA de CV.
